title: LLM repeatability report (1204-07, D-24)
description: The D-24 LLM-repeatability report. A SEPARATE schema from the deterministic legs report (tools/de01/report_schema.json) on purpose: the two artifacts must never be pooled, averaged, or differenced into one number (D-24). No top-level field name in this schema appears in the deterministic schema, so a pooling join has no key to join on by construction. This schema carries NO accuracy field and NO expected-label field: the LLM half reports agreement and stability, never correctness against an oracle (D-18).

reportLabel.description: Names what this report does and does not measure.

sampleIndexBase.description: Sample indices are 1..k. Index 0 is the legacy D-21 cassette key and is never used as a sample.

providerStrata.description: One entry per (provider, item) pair. There is deliberately no combined/pooled cell across providers (D-13) AND no combined/pooled cell across items: repeat_sweep.compute_item_metrics computes strata per item, and pooling heterogeneous items (each a different rule-ingest prompt or recognition case) into one modal-agreement figure would be substantively misleading -- different prompts have different correct outputs by construction, so a naive cross-item pool reads as near-total instability regardless of how stable any single item actually is. A single-item run still validates: it simply has one entry.

item.description: The item_id this stratum's n samples were drawn for (repeat_sweep.py's item_id, e.g. one D-12 rule-ingest prompt name). Never a pooled/combined value.

modalAgreement.description: modal_count / n, or the string 'insufficient samples' below the min-5 floor (D-13).

wilsonLower.description: Wilson 95% lower bound from scoring.wilson_interval(modal_count, n), or 'insufficient samples' below the floor.

outcomeTallies.description: D-14 proposal-outcome tallies only. Never canonical verdict statuses (D-14 vs 1200).
